title: fix: hide quest progress bar once reward is claimed
author: CloudCompile

gist.summary: Claimed quests no longer show an “N / N” progress bar after the reward is claimed. Open and claimable quests still show their progress.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel-art garden, Polli tucks a completed quest card into a tiny reward satchel while open quest cards still have progress bars beside lime green (#ecf874) code-plants. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small within the scene, with cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
